title: Payload-agnostic core
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code. QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code: “The container, the signature and the transport encoding are the same for every GDHCN trust domain ... What changes from one use case to the next is only the payload”.

statements.label: Payload-agnostic core
statements.requirement: The modules for steps 3 to 9 SHALL NOT depend on any payload logical model. Payloads SHALL be plugged in through a PayloadCodec registered against a subclaim.
